bugs.what: respondCmd calls loadConfig and userConfigPath, which main.mjs does not import, so every pr-review respond command fails with a ReferenceError turned into a usage error.
runSetup returns the cached result of a finished setup before it resets the worktree, so a resumed run lets the seats read a worktree that a check left dirty.
git clean -fdxq leaves a nested git repository that a check created; it needs -ff, so the next check and the seats see it.
applyProof finds the tally by fingerprint only; two clusters can share a fingerprint (it has no line), so a finding gets the other cluster's tally and its proof and severity are wrong.
The Unproven mark is appended at the end of the body, but a finding off the diff posts only its first line, so the mark is lost.
leftOut counts a must that proof lowered below the review-3 severity floor as left out by the effort limit, which a higher effort would not post either.
